name: Select
description: A native dropdown for choosing one option from a short list, with a label and messages.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, connected to the select.

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }[]

props.name: placeholder
props.description: A disabled first option shown before a choice is made.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Marks the field invalid.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All native attributes of the underlying element.

a11y: Uses the native <select>, so keyboard, screen readers and mobile pickers work as expected.
The label is a real <label>; hint and error are linked with aria-describedby.
